claim: ADR-045: gstack/gbrain/CRG Error Resilience & Safe Defaults. Core framework: (1) Pre-flight error detection (_detect_errors checks CLI, engine status, autopilot jam, stale locks, concurrent writes). (2) Error prevention (timeout guards GBRAIN_TIMEOUT=120/GIT_TIMEOUT=30, retry with exponential backoff 1s→2s→4s, file-based locks for state safety). (3) Error handling (exit code 0/1/7/8/124/127 with recovery strategies). (4) Error messages (use _err_actionable for root cause + actionable fix). (5) Logging (central ~/.openclaw/logs/gstack-gbrain-crg.log). (6) Health checks (post-operation verification). All patterns in bin/orama-system/scripts/lib/gstack-gbrain-crg-safe.sh.
conditions: gstack gbrain crg error handling resilience safety preflights

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04: Fixed /sync-gbrain and all skills using gstack/gbrain/CRG. Root cause was lack of pre-flight checks, no timeout guards, no retry logic, no clear error messages. New framework ensures any agent can run these tools reliably.
